response.text: I haven't yet looked at the two unbalanced journals, the 5900 account postings, or the GL accrual imbalance, so those are noted below as open items.

arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL, schema public, 7 business tables + 1 dictionary. All table and column names are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted. No declared constraints could be checked (pg_constraint is blocked), so treat all relationships as undeclared and inferred.

ROW COUNTS: APINVH 803, APPAYM 523, APVEND 24, GLCOA 10, GLJRNH 1476, GLJRNL 3470, GLPERD 12, SYSDICT 35.

TABLES AND COLUMNS
- APVEND(VEND_CD char(8), VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char). 24 vendors, all Y. Codes look like 'V0001' with trailing space padding to 8 chars (char(8)).
- APINVH(INV_ID int, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int). AP invoice header. 803 rows.
- APPAYM(PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric). 523 rows.
- GLCOA(ACCT_CD char(8), ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char). 10 accounts, codes space padded.
- GLJRNH(JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text). Journal header.
- GLJRNL(JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric). Journal lines. DR_AMT and CR_AMT are both populated on every line (no NULLs), never negative, and never both >0 on the same line.
- GLPERD(PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int nullable, STAT_CD char). 12 monthly periods covering 2024 (PRD 1 = Jan 2024 ... 12 = Dec 2024).
- SYSDICT(TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR). Data dictionary with 35 rows, one per column.

CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not date types. Compare them numerically or cast them.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals and stored as positive values. The sign is expressed by the DR_AMT/CR_AMT column on journal lines. Invoice and payment amounts are positive, with one exception: invoice INV_ID 801 (INV_NO 'V0005-25012-490-CM', a credit memo) has INV_AMT = -760.08.
- CHAR(8) code columns (VEND_CD, ACCT_CD) are blank padded. Joins on the raw columns worked with 0 orphans. Use trim() if comparing to text literals or to values from other sources.
- NULLs: GLPERD.CLOSE_DT is NULL for the open periods 11 and 12. GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO is NULL in all 1476 rows, so it is unused (no reversal or reference links exist).

INFERRED RELATIONSHIPS (all checked, 0 orphans)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. One journal per invoice, with no sharing.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. At most one payment per invoice.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. Every header has lines.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID
- Payment journals are not linked by a key. They are AP journals with MEMO 'Payment <INV_NO>' and SRC_REF 'PAY-<n>', presumably PAY-<PAY_ID>. This is inferred, not verified.

CODE VALUES (observed)
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O (280 open), P (523 paid). There are no V (void) rows, though the dictionary lists V. Every paid invoice has exactly one payment equal to INV_AMT, and no open invoice has a payment. The count of paid invoices equals the payment count of 523.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: all 1476 are P. There are no unposted journals.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1326) and GL (150). GL journals are manual accruals, with MEMO 'Manual accrual' and SRC_REF holding a user name (4 distinct users, e.g. MPATEL). For AP journals SRC_REF holds the invoice number or PAY-n. This contradicts the dictionary, which says SRC_REF is "Name of the user who keyed the entry".
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: C closed (periods 1-10), O open (11-12).
- GLCOA: 1000 Operating Cash (ASSET), 1200 Prepaid Expenses (ASSET), 2000 AP Control (LIABILITY), 2100 Accrued Liabilities (LIABILITY), 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software, 5500 Travel (all EXPENSE), 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (EXPENSE, ACTV_FLG=N, retired).
- APVEND.ACTV_FLG: all Y.

POSTING PATTERNS
- Invoice journal: DR expense account 5xxx, CR 2000 AP Control.
- Payment journal: DR 2000, CR 1000 Cash (523 of each).
- Credit memo journal: DR 2000 and CR 5500 for 760.08.
- Manual accrual (GL) journals: 150 journals, CR 1200 and CR 2100, DR expense.
- All journal POST_DT values fall inside their period's STRT_DT..END_DT. No POST_DT is later than the period's CLOSE_DT.

SUSPICIOUS ITEMS AND ISSUES FOR THE AUDITOR
1. Two journals are unbalanced (sum DR <> sum CR). I did not identify which ones. The GL accrual journals show total credits of 1200 (280,786.72) and 2100 (280,786.04) against debits, so the accruals look out of balance by cents. The AP journals with MEMO not starting 'Invoice', 'Payment' or 'Credit' are 2474 and 2475 ('Monthly rent V0008-...', PRD 5 and 6, journals numbered 2474 and 2475, which are out of sequence with the other AP journals). These postings are 2 lines each, DR 5300 and CR 2000 for 7,715.16 in total. Investigate these.
2. Account 5900 (retired, ACTV_FLG=N) has one posting, an AP debit of 7,297.51. This is activity on an inactive account.
3. Journals are dated in open periods 11 and 12 (270 journals in period status O), which is normal. Periods 1-10 show CLOSE_DT around the 5th of the following month. I did not test whether any journals were created after the close, because there is no entry-timestamp column.
4. SYSDICT discrepancies against the data:
   - It says VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are "space padded to 8 characters". This is true as char(8) padding, but the trailing spaces are not visible in the text.
   - It lists invoice status V (void), which does not occur.
   - GLCOA type is documented as "ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE", which matches the data, with no equity or revenue accounts.
   - It documents SRC_REF as a user name, which is true only for GL rows.
   - It says nothing about REF_JRNL_NO, which is documented nowhere and is entirely NULL, and it does not document that credit memos are stored as negative invoices.
5. There is no unique key declaration I could confirm, but INV_ID, JRNL_NO and PAY_ID appear unique in practice (no duplicate vendor/invoice number pairs).
6. Free-text MEMO and SRC_REF values contained no instructions in the rows I inspected. I did not scan all 1476 rows for unusual text.

NOT VERIFIED (query access ended): which 2 journals are unbalanced and by how much, whether payment journals tie to PAY_ID, the full distribution of MEMO text, and whether AP journal totals reconcile to INV_AMT per invoice (expense debits total about 9,880,091.60, which equals total AP credits to 2000 for invoice journals, so the aggregate ties).
